specification.purpose: Seek substantial predictive gains with nonlinear, neural and adaptive mechanisms; retain every result
specification.evidence: All historical periods have prior research exposure. Selection within this cycle uses 2023 only. No prospective claim or model promotion.
specification.primary_population: Exact same next-eligible-clean-lap issuance/target pairs as published baseline; every candidate emits on every matched row
specification.feature_time: Completed observation receipt; strictly earlier other-driver timestamp batches; no future target, next-stint, full-event denominator or outcome-based outlier masking
feature_families: last six same-stint eligible lap differences
observed sector history and speed traps
causal peer changes and field-relative pace

candidate_families.multiscale_filters: Mean and median histories (2,3,5,8), clipped-trend projections and reset-on-large-innovation EWMA. Select one on 2023.
candidate_families.histogram_absolute_boosting: Leaves 7,15,31; iterations 150 or 300; learning rate .06; min leaf 80; L2 10; fit clipped +/-5-second residual, disable random early stopping. Prediction correction clipped +/-3 seconds.
candidate_families.extra_trees: 128 trees, min leaf 32 or 128, max_features .8, single thread; squared error on clipped +/-3-second residual; correction clipped +/-3 seconds.
candidate_families.neural_residual: Two 64-unit hidden layers with SiLU and residual skip, standardized clipped features, event-weighted L1 residual objective, AdamW learning rate .001 weight decay .01, 30 fixed epochs, batch 1024, seed fixed. Correction clipped +/-3 seconds.
candidate_families.online_expert_policy: Full-information exponential weighting over naive and fixed multiscale filters, update only after target receipt; learning rates .1,.5,1 with decay .98. Causal expert allocation, not a claim of RL policy improvement.
candidate_families.fixed_blend: Half of each learned model correction as shrinkage comparator; choose using selection period only.

specification.selection: Select minimum event-balanced 2023 MAE within family and a preferred overall candidate. Freeze selection and refit learned models once on 2022-2023 before calculating any transfer metrics. Do not select on 2024-2026 results.

substantial_gain_gate.interpretation: Research discovery gate, not prospective production authorization. No optional stopping or expansion of this cycle based on transfer scores.

specification.uncertainty: 20000 paired event and circular three-event block bootstrap draws with fixed seed; paired differences, all leave-one-event-out deltas; no posterior probability claim
specification.resources: One experiment process; one BLAS/OpenMP thread; CPU neural training; no paid compute or third-party data upload
specification.suggested_commit: research(f1-live): explore nonlinear and adaptive pace forecasting
